answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Work waits on the glacier until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vault of the next round. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the opal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
